name: Ixidor
title: The Reality Sculptor
summary: Grief over Nivea's death led Ixidor to reshape reality and create Akroma to destroy Phage.
biography: Ixidor was an illusionist whose relationship with Nivea ended in tragedy after a lethal arena confrontation with Phage.
In grief, he developed the ability to make imagined forms real. Akroma was his most consequential creation, an angel shaped by the loss of Nivea and driven toward vengeance.
The conflict between Akroma and Phage escaped the bounds of Ixidor's private motives and became part of Otaria's wider devastation.

Nivea’s death gave his later reality-shaping a specific origin. Ixidor’s response was not to heal the damage done by the Cabal’s games but to create a being capable of pursuing the person he held responsible. He thus transformed private mourning into a new source of public violence.

Akroma’s existence made the conflict difficult to contain. Her extraordinary power and devotion to vengeance drew followers beyond Ixidor’s immediate grievance, while the opponent she targeted was Jeska remade as Phage through another chain of injury and coercion.

Ixidor, Reality Sculptor belongs to the original Onslaught publication period. Later Akroma depictions may commemorate his most famous creation or imagine alternate versions, but they should not be read as new eyewitness illustrations of Nivea’s death.

featuredCard.significance: Ixidor's original Onslaught card, portraying the illusionist who could realize imagined beings.
